name: THE PATRONS
note: A drinker AND his stool, as one sprite, drawn by pointing the generator at this plate so his lean and his stool fit THIS bar. Three sprites rather than one, because their feet are at y508, y661 and y718 -- a hundred and eighty pixels of depth between the far one and the near one, and one anchor could not sort them against Thad.
